note: Not a new PNG tree. Filter over the existing 228/16/16 split using the frozen p649 overlap260 usability map. PNG / Ec / Es stay as-is.

cache.reason: Same protocol-A PNGs. Sampler only skips (font, char) pairs; no new ContentImage, no cache rebuild.

exclude_role: no GT, no donor, no style pool

train_sample.name: v0913_clean.train.s50_k38_b12
train_sample.rule: Two-stage: sample script_group with fixed p, then uniform over allowed (font, char) in that group. Style refs stay random n-shot from the same font's 338 Han. Exclude fonts never appear.
train_sample.within_group: uniform over masked pairs; kana keeps natural 83:86; latin keeps natural 10:52:27
train_sample.why_not_uniform_pairs: Uniform-over-pairs is 35/56/9. Kana would take most steps; bopomofo would starve; Latin is the paper headline.
train_sample.why_these_rates: Latin primary 50%. Kana cut from 56% to 38% but not starved (still the largest unique-pair set). Bopomofo boosted from 9% to 12% — only 130 fonts × 37 chars, so do not go to 1/3 or it over-repeats.
train_sample.style_refs: 338 Han StyleImage of the same font; eval ref8 永和书风骨韵天地 may appear as style, never as western target
train_sample.delta_library: train fonts minus exclude; a donor may contribute Δ for char C only if C's script is usable on that donor

cn2cn.help: Possible later as a small auxiliary, not in the first clean F2.
cn2cn.blocker: ContentImage is 295 western only. Ec content keys are 295 only. Proper 中→中 needs 338 Noto Han ContentImage + 338 Ec content keys — that is a cache change. Using StyleImage as content would mix content domains. Do not do either in v0913_clean.
cn2cn.already_have: Every train step already conditions on Chinese StyleImage via Es. That is 中 style, not 中→中 generation.

if_later.name: v0913_clean+cn2cn10
if_later.requires: 338 Noto Han ContentImage + Ec content keys. Separate dataset increment. Do not mix into the first clean-data vs dirty-data ablation.
